title: Mental age test: how old is your mind? Free quiz — cv.cm
description: Free mental age test: answer 12 questions about weekends, food, money and music to find out whether your mind is a kid's, a teen's, a grown-up's or an old soul's. Just for fun, no sign-up.
lede: Do you still squeal at puppies, live for the group chat, plan your week or go to bed at nine? Answer 12 questions to find out how old you are at heart.
about: Your mental age here is a playful read on your habits and outlook, not your maturity or intelligence. The quiz sorts answers into four ages: a kid at heart (7–12), a teen (13–19), a grown-up (20–39) and an old soul (40+).

In psychology, "mental age" once meant the age at which a child performs on an intelligence test; this quiz has nothing to do with that and does not measure IQ. It was written for cv.cm, every result is equally likely, and your answers stay in your browser.

faq.q: What mental ages can I get?
faq.a: Kid at heart (7–12), teen spirit (13–19), grown-up (20–39) and old soul (40+). Your result shows how strongly you match all four.

faq.q: Is a younger or older mental age better?
faq.a: Neither. A young mental age means you are playful and curious; an older one means you are calm and settled. Most people are a mix.

faq.q: Is this an accurate mental age test?
faq.a: It is a fun quiz, not a psychological test. There is no scientific measure of mental age for adults.

kid.name: Kid at heart (mental age 7–12)
kid.body: You are playful, curious and easily delighted, and you still see wonder in ordinary things. You make friends fast and bring fun wherever you go. Just remember the grown-up stuff now and then, like bills and bedtime.

teen.name: Teen spirit (mental age 13–19)
teen.body: You are spontaneous, social and passionate, always up on trends and ready for a late night. You feel things strongly and stand up for your friends. A bit of planning would save you some last-minute panic.

adult.name: Grown-up (mental age 20–39)
adult.body: You are practical and balanced: you plan ahead, handle responsibilities and still make time for fun. People count on you to get things done. Don't forget to switch off sometimes.

elder.name: Old soul (mental age 40+)
elder.body: You are calm, thoughtful and wise beyond your years. You value quiet routines, real conversations and things that last. Friends come to you for advice. Now and then, let yourself be silly.
